historical.inspection_outcome: The review closed without an inspection.
historical.difference: That case had a single thermal pattern.

historical.outcome: outcome: the inspection found no damage. The case was closed.
historical.lesson: lesson: an acoustic window plus a vessel track is a reason to look, not to control equipment.
